lineage.description: Drone orthomosaic imagery was acquired post-Tropical Storm Chalane over Zomba, Malawi by GLOBHE using crowddroning methodology. The georeferenced orthomosaic enables visual assessment and mapping of storm-induced damage to buildings and landscape features.
